exposure: Smartphone-based interactive blood glucose management system with software surveillance (NET-Health application)
outcome: Resource utilisation (occasions of service, clinician time, financial cost)
cohort: The study included 98 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who used the NET-Health application, compared to 94 historical controls with GDM.
finding: The smartphone-based application resulted in high patient satisfaction and reduced resource utilisation without significant differences in maternal or neonatal outcomes, demonstrating a financial benefit.
